items.question: Are SBS and SMRT the same?

answer.short_answer: No, SBS and SMRT are separate public transport operators in Singapore.
answer.explanation: SBS Transit and SMRT are distinct companies operating public transport services in Singapore. SBS Transit operates buses and several MRT and LRT lines, while SMRT operates other bus packages and MRT lines. They compete for bus service contracts and specialize in different districts, indicating they are not the same entity [1].
